summary: The change correctly limits archive retirement to rows already in the archive, so a reservation moved out of the live ledger survives the transition when the archive is at its ceiling. The new test covers both direct compaction and the trusted writer plus durable reader path.

evidence: The full-archive path now retires only pre-existing archive rows, preserving the row moved from the live ledger so `validateRepairTransition` accepts the otherwise recoverable admission.

The added test constructs the 2048 live plus 16384 archive state, verifies the moved reservation remains readable, and confirms the trusted writer applies the overflow write and the archive reader sees the expected rows.

The broader issue requirements are present at this head: terminal settled reservations are compacted into `reservationArchive`, capacity refusal is distinct through `ReservationLedgerCapacityError`, implementation admission records a `ledger_capacity` park, and the plan diagnostic carries `attempted`, `deferred`, and `deferredByReason`.
